g.text: Assigned outdoor35°C50% RH and return24°C50% RH at the same pressure. Mixed state follows exact W and h mass weighting; the chart connector is nearly
straight because moist-air cp depends on W. Mass weights are dry-air rates, not total moist-air rates. No condensation occurs.
